d:
Bored during their extended vacation, Tapu Sena visits Sonu’s house. When Bhide tries to send them away, Tapu warns him about child labor laws for making Sonu pack papad. Tapu Sena insists on helping pack them, but ends up crushing and ruining Madhavi’s papad, forcing Bhide to kick them out into the compound.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
